title: The Witches' Prophecy
content: The three witches foretold: 'All hail, Macbeth, that shalt be king hereafter!' 'Thou shalt get kings, though thou be none.' 'None of woman born shall harm Macbeth.'
content_zh: 三个女巫曾预言：「万福，麦克白，你日后将为王。」「你虽不为王，你的子孙却将为王。」「凡女人所生者，皆不能伤害麦克白。」
dm_notes: Encourage discussion of whether the prophecy is truth, temptation, or a trap. Do not explain its final line.

title: Macbeth's Letter to His Wife
content: 'I have encountered something strange. They foretold that I would become king. You have often said that I am too full of the milk of human kindness and lack resolve. Now fate lays a gift before me, yet I am afraid.'
content_zh: 「我遇见了一件怪异的事。她们预言我将成为国王。你常说我的仁慈太多、决断太少。如今命运把礼物放到我面前，我却害怕。」
dm_notes: Found between the pages of the chronicle in Macbeth's room. Give it privately to the finder first.

title: Malcolm's Diary
content: Malcolm wrote: 'Father has rejected my proposal yet again. He sees only my recklessness and refuses to see the ambition in Macbeth's eyes. This country needs a sword, not a king who forever hides behind a shield.' A servant also heard him pacing angrily in his room.
content_zh: 马尔康写道：「父亲又一次驳回我的提议。他只看见我的鲁莽，却看不见麦克白眼中的野心。这个国家需要的是一把剑，不是一个永远躲在盾牌后面的国王。」一名仆人也听见他在房里愤怒地踱步。
dm_notes: Found in the lining of Malcolm's cloak. It creates suspicion but does not prove murder.

title: Banquo's Testimony
content: Banquo's diary reads: 'Today Macbeth was made Thane of Cawdor, though the victory belonged to us both. Those strange sisters trouble me; the instruments of darkness often tell us truths in small matters only to betray us later.' An unsent note adds: 'I, Banquo, beg a private meeting in the eastern chamber at midnight on a matter concerning the safety of the realm.'
content_zh: 班柯的日记写着：「今日麦克白受封科多尔勋爵，可那份战功本属于我们两个人。那三个奇异的女子让我不安——黑暗的器具常常先在小事上说真话，只为日后背叛我们。」另有一封未寄出的字条：「我，班柯，恳请于午夜在东厢私下会面，事关王国安危。」
dm_notes: Found beneath the raised stone near Banquo's bed. It shows that Banquo concealed part of the prophecy and his true position.

title: The Bloodstained Gown
content: A lady's formal gown was found in Macbeth's chamber. Dark red stains remain around the cuffs despite repeated washing.
content_zh: 在麦克白的房间里发现一件女式礼服长袍。袖口反复洗过，仍留着暗红色的痕迹。
dm_notes: Do not directly identify the blood. Let players connect the gown, daggers, and staged scene.

title: The Cellar Keeper's Testimony
content: The cellar keeper saw Macbeth pacing alone in the eastern gallery near midnight, too disturbed to answer a greeting. On Lady Macbeth's order, the keeper also released a bottle of potent poppy extract, supposedly for sleep, to a visibly anxious servant.
content_zh: 地窖看守看见麦克白在午夜前后独自沿着东廊踱步，心神不宁，连招呼都顾不上回应。看守还按麦克白夫人的吩咐，把一瓶效力很强的鸦片酊——说是助眠之用——交给了一位神色紧张的仆人。
dm_notes: Guide players to consider the real purpose of the poppy extract and Macbeth's movements.

title: Macduff's Secret
content: Testimony from one of Macduff's retainers reveals that Macduff was not delivered by natural birth, but was taken from his mother's womb by Caesarean section.
content_zh: 麦克德夫的一名随从供称：他不是自然降生，而是从母亲腹中以剖腹之术取出。
dm_notes: Release late in discussion to explain the double meaning of 'none of woman born.'

title: The Broken Pact
content: Macduff holds the right half of a secret letter: 'I see his ambition spread like wildfire while His Majesty remains blind. Though my family bears disgrace, Scotland stands above private grievance. If Your Highness will act for the realm's future, I pledge my service. Burn this after reading. —M.' Malcolm holds the left half, which warns of danger beneath the glory of the Thane of Cawdor.
content_zh: 麦克德夫握着密信的后半页：「我看见他的野心如野火蔓延，而陛下依旧失明。纵然我的家族蒙受耻辱，苏格兰仍高于私怨。若殿下愿为王国的将来出手，我愿效命。读后即焚。——M。」马尔康握着前半页，警示科多尔勋爵的荣光之下藏着危险。
dm_notes: Found in the hollow base of the candlestick in Macduff's room. It reveals their secret alliance.

title: The Guard's Ring
content: A silver ring was hidden in the ashes of the crime-scene fireplace. Malcolm's personal guard's crest is engraved inside it. The ring was found in the eastern guest chamber where Duncan died.
content_zh: 案发现场的壁炉灰烬里藏着一枚银戒，内侧刻着马尔康亲卫的族徽。它出现在邓肯遇刺的那间东厢客房。
dm_notes: Found in the fireplace ashes. Give it privately to the finder, who may decide whether to reveal it.

title: A Servant's Testimony
content: A servant reports: 'Around midnight, Lord Banquo stopped me and asked endless questions about the castle watch. We spoke for nearly a quarter of an hour. It was strange; nobles never concern themselves with such details.'
content_zh: 一名仆人禀报：「午夜前后，班柯大人叫住我，问了许久的城堡守夜安排，我们说了近一刻钟。这很奇怪——贵族从不会在意这样的细节。」
dm_notes: Banquo may have cleared Macbeth's route or merely investigated the watch. Do not decide his motive for the players.

title: Duncan's Secret Order
content: King Duncan wrote: 'Macbeth has served with distinction, yet ambition burns in his eyes. The witches' words may not be empty. Upon returning to court tomorrow, I shall begin stripping Macbeth of military command. Keep this matter secret.'
content_zh: 国王邓肯写道：「麦克白战功卓著，可他眼中有野心在烧。女巫的话未必是空。明日回朝之后，我要开始收回他的兵权。此事保密。」
dm_notes: Unlock when players argue that prophecy alone is too weak a motive. It reveals Macbeth's urgent fear of losing power.
